assessments.contract: In the non-arbitrary_precision branch, owned serde_json::Value numeric deserialization delegates to Number::deserialize_any; Number dispatches its Float variant to visit_f64. The serde_core f32 Deserialize visitor casts f64 to f32, preserving sign under the shown std branch, without a field-specific finite/positive check. In the arbitrary_precision branch the number invokes the target method which parses and passes that target to its visitor; this is a distinct conditional route.

assessments.kind: current conditional source assessment related to existing issue, no new count
assessments.contract: Current EquipmentPhysical stores dimensions as [f32;3] and grip/anchor components as f32. The current JSON value validator requires each dimension to be finite positive in f64 and grip/anchor values finite with their own nonnegative/signed rules. The typed preflight is decoded from a clone and discarded, while build source later serializes the original Value. Under the inspected non-arbitrary_precision Value/Number/visitor branch and otherwise valid catalog conditions, a sufficiently small positive f64 can cast to f32 zero, while sufficiently large finite signed anchor or nonnegative grip values can cast to infinity during that typed preflight.
